Discovery advertises only ES256; OpenID certification requires RS256 in id_token_signing_alg_values_supported. Must be resolved in Phase 2 (M1 signing keys) before Basic/Config OP can pass.
M0 discovery has no userinfo_endpoint; removed in Phase 2 when /userinfo is implemented and advertised.

/jwks returns an explicit 501 in M0 (no signing keys yet); this is callAndStopOnFailure, so the module stops here (INTERRUPTED). Removed in Phase 2 when /jwks serves keys; later conditions will then surface and must be added or fixed.
